messages: zoe: Dropped a new compact layout for the routing rules list. Main goals: reduce height, keep reordering discoverable, and make preview updates clearer. Figma link: https://redwood.design/f/compact-rules-v6 mike: Nice. First glance: compacting is fine but the priority chip relies on color alone now. We should add a numeric rank (1,2,3) and a subtle chevron so it's readable at a glance. anya: Copy nit on the inline validation: currently says "Rule conflict". Can we make it friendlier: "Rule not applied: conflicts with rule 2. Open to resolve." Also add a small "View conflict" link inside the message. kevin: Keyboard accessibility: propose two patterns — (1) keyboard reorder using Space to pick up + Arrow keys to move, or (2) focus moves to a numeric input where you can type desired position. Prefer (1) for discoverability. Need a clear focus style and a live update announce. jun: Mobile drag suggestions: long-press to enter reorder mode, then drag handle appears. Touch target should be >=44px per our guidelines. Right now some handles are ~28px. zoe: Agreed on rank + icon. I'll add an aria-hidden visual chip and a visually-hidden label: #1 and Preview updated: 8 matches``` jun: One UX edge: when rules are re-ordered, the preview snapshot should indicate which rules influenced the match. Maybe a small badge on each preview row like "matched by rule #3" so users can quickly correlate. ozoe: (typo) meant zoe. zoe: Good call @jun. We'll add a micro-badge that reads "matched by #N"; also include aria-describedby that points to the rule title so screen readers can read full context. mike: Developer note: when the sandbox runs, emit a telemetry event `ui.policy.sandbox.run` with payload: policy_id, user_id, run_id, sample_size. Also include a `ui.policy.sandbox.result` with counts when finished. anya: Accessibility microcopy: tooltips should include action verbs. Example: "Reorder rule (press Space, then Arrow keys)" for the handle. kevin: One more: contrast of the compact separators dips below AA on dark mode when list has many nested rules. Increase separator alpha to 0.12 or use stroke token. ui-bot: Sandbox run queued (run_id=run-9a7b). CI job: ux-compact-792. zoe: Thanks all. Action items: 1) add numeric rank + chevron, 2) implement Space+Arrow reorder with focus ring, 3) bump touch targets to 44px, 4) change toast copy, 5) sandbox button (secondary) + telemetry events, 6) preview badges and aria-describedby. I'll open the PR and tag for design-review. Targeting a small patch by Wednesday.
